name: Headline box
what: A two-line headline above your head: the first line pops in bold, word by word; then a box opens on the second line and grows word by word as its dark words pop in inside it; the headline pushes in slowly while it holds, and at the end the box folds back and the words fade up.
origin: Rebuilt after the headline-box and split-headline effects of claude-video-effects (MIT): a bold line over a line in a box - MotionLab's own code, kept off the face in a shot with a person
motion: from f0 the first line's words pop in one every gap (3) frames: each shows in 3 f and settles in 7 f from 70 % with a small overshoot, rising a quarter of the size (slow end); 3 f after the first line the box opens on the second line (5 f, slow end) and grows to the right word by word (5 f S-curve each) as its words pop in; it pushes in 3 % over the hold (gentle S-curve); the last 8 f the box folds to its left edge and the words fade up 24 px (accelerating)

tracks.name: line 1
tracks.what: the first line pops in word by word

tracks.name: box
tracks.what: the box opens on the second line and grows word by word as its words pop in

tracks.name: out
tracks.what: the box folds back and the words fade up

min_frames: start + round(((parts(line1, ' ') + parts(line2, ' ')) * max(1, gap) + 20) * fps / 30)
min_why: every word has to pop in before it ends
